legacy_sources.product: Vector Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Vector Bidding Science
legacy_sources.excerpt:
1: The opportunity
2: We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our Vector Bidding Science team. In this role, you will define the technical vision and architect the next generation of scalable real-time bidding systems powered by cutting-edge AI, marketplace intelligence, and advanced optimization frameworks.
3: As a key member of the Vector AI org, you will play a pivotal role in advancing Unity’s high-scale ads engine. By harnessing massive datasets and rich signals, you will develop state-of-the-art bidding and pacing algorithms that automatically maximize advertisers’ returns.
4: What you’ll be doing
5: Design, implement, and optimize core bidding algorithms and auction mechanisms
6: Architect and scale bid landscape forecasting capabilities
7: Analyze large-scale marketplace dynamics to uncover deep insights and deliver algorithmic improvements
8: Drive offline evaluations and online A/B experiments to validate model performance and deliver measurable business impact
9: Collaborate cross-functionally with product, infrastructure, and engineering teams
10: What we’re looking for
11: Hands-on experience in state-of-the-art machine learning, reinforcement learning, and control theory to complex, real-world bidding or pricing problems
12: Strong software engineering skills in Python and experience with deep learning frameworks, preferably PyTorch
13: Solid understanding of metric design, online experimentation frameworks (A/B testing), and large-scale data analysis
14: Proven ability to lead projects end-to-end and deliver measurable business impact in an ambiguous technical landscape
15: You might also have
16: Experience working with large datasets and distributed computing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Ray, BigQuery, Flink)
17: Experience building real-time ad systems, specifically in DSP (Demand-Side Platform) bidding logic, survival analysis for market price estimation, or game-theoretic modeling
18: Experience leveraging AI tools (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor) to accelerate development
19: Additional information
20: Gross Annual Salary: $148,700 - $244,600 USD
21: This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in our company incentive plans (such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions). The final offer amount will depend on several factors, including geographic location and the candidate’s relevant experience, professional background, and skill set.
22: Benefits
23: At Unity, we want our team members to thrive. We offer a wide range of benefits designed to support well-being and work-life balance.
24: Please note: Benefits eligibility, specific offerings, and coverage vary based on the country and employment status.
25: While specific benefits vary, here are some of the ways we strive to take care of our eligible team members globally: Comprehensive health, life, and disability insurance | Commute subsidy | Employee stock ownership | Competitive retirement/pension plans | Generous vacation and personal days | Support for new parents through leave and family-care programs | Office food snacks | Mental Health and Wellbeing programs and support | Employee Resource Groups | Global Employee Assistance Program | Training and development programs | Volunteering and donation matching program
26: Life at Unity
27: Unity [NYSE: U] is the world’s leading game engine, powering play for more than 3 billion consumers each month. The top mobile games in the world, the most played PC indie titles, the most innovative console games, and virtually all of the top XR and Web Games are developed, deployed, and grown in Unity. Unity also enables teams across industries like automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare to design, simulate, and collaborate in 3D — closing the gap between ideas and reality. For more information, please visit
28: www.unity.com
